INSERT_TRANSACTION_QUERY: INSERT INTO user_transactions (user_id, title, category, amount, date, icon, month_label, avoidable, reason) VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)
GET_TRANSACTIONS_QUERY: SELECT id, title, category, amount, date, icon, month_label, avoidable, reason FROM user_transactions WHERE user_id = %s ORDER BY id DESC
